{{Engineer infobox}}

Rosa Dayette specialises in range and targeting modifications for suits and handheld weapons.<ref name="inara-list" />

Odyssey Engineering is a separate system from ship Engineering — it modifies suits and handheld weapons rather than ship modules, and exists only in Live (there is no Legacy equivalent). See [[Engineers]] for how the two systems are organised.

== Location ==
* '''System:''' Kojeara
* '''Settlement:''' Rosa's Shop
* '''Region:''' Colonia — this Engineer is only reachable after making the long journey to the Colonia region, separate from the core bubble.

== How to Discover This Engineer ==
Rosa Dayette is independently available and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-list">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>

== How to Receive an Invitation ==
There is no separate invitation requirement distinct from the unlock requirement below.

== How to Unlock This Engineer ==
Unlock requirements summary:
* Sell a combined total of '''10 Culinary Recipes and/or Cocktail Recipes''' to stations in the Colonia system.

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Rosa Dayette]].

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==
Rosa Dayette is one of three independent Colonia Odyssey Engineers (alongside [[Baltanos]] and [[Eleanor Bresa]]) whose referral tasks all feed into [[Yi Shen]].<ref name="inara-list" />

After Rosa Dayette is unlocked, delivering '''10 Manufacturing Instructions''' data completes the referral task toward Yi Shen. All three Colonia Engineers' referral tasks must be completed before Yi Shen becomes available.
